# About
Triple G Roofing & Construction is a small, local, family-owned and operated father-and-son company based in Humble, Texas, serving the Greater Houston area since 1973. Glenn and Tim Menn are the men behind the business; owner Tim Menn is on every job personally to oversee the work and make sure everything is done as agreed. The company handles roofing and the rest of the home's exterior — roof replacement (architectural shingle and metal), roof repair, roof inspections, hail, wind and hurricane damage repair, attic venting, gutters, siding, fascia and soffit, wood-rot repair, exterior paint, patio covers, enclosed and screened patios, pergolas, wood decks, fences and gates. Inspections and written estimates are free, and no job is too big or small. Triple G was voted a Nextdoor Neighborhood Favorite in 2022, 2023 and 2024.

# Services
1. Roof Replacement — full architectural-shingle and metal roof replacements: tear-off, decking repair, underlayment, new roof, clean job site (magnet nail sweep, landscaping and pools protected).
2. Roof Repair — leak repairs, flashing and pipe-boot fixes, shingle replacement, rotted-decking repair.
3. Roof Inspection — free, photo-documented inspections with a clear written estimate.
4. Storm & Wind Damage Roof Repair — hail, wind and hurricane damage repair; help through the insurance claim process from beginning to end.
5. Roof Damage Repair — wood rot, failed flashing, damaged decking and worn shingles on aging roofs.
6. Attic Venting — balanced intake and exhaust ventilation that lowers attic heat and protects shingles; shingle manufacturers can void or limit shingle warranties when the attic is not properly ventilated.
7. Gutter Installation — new gutters and downspouts that move water away from the foundation, fascia and soffit.
8. Siding, Fascia & Soffit — siding repair and replacement (including Hardie/fiber-cement and vinyl), fascia and soffit, wood-rot repair, window re-sealing, exterior paint, interior sheetrock repair tied to exterior work.
9. Patio Covers, Pergolas & Decks — custom patio covers (shingle or metal), enclosed and screened patios, pergolas, wood decks, thatch-to-metal palapa conversions.
10. Fences & Gates — cedar and pine privacy fences, ranch rail, custom gates; new builds, repairs and replacements.

# Insurance Claims
Triple G has more than 50 years of claims, claims-handling/adjuster and insurance knowledge and experience. The company helps homeowners through the entire claims process from beginning to end: documenting damage with photos, explaining the policy in plain English, and meeting the adjuster on-site. Whether a claim is covered is always the insurance carrier's decision; Triple G does not promise coverage or outcomes.

# Common Questions
**How long has Triple G Roofing & Construction been in business?**
Since 1973 — more than 50 years serving the Greater Houston area as a family-owned father-and-son team.

**Where is Triple G based and where does it work?**
Based in Humble, TX, serving the Greater Houston area — from Orange to Galveston and sometimes beyond — including the 50 communities listed above.

**Does Triple G charge for inspections or estimates?**
No. Inspections and written estimates are free.

**Does Triple G help with insurance claims?**
Yes — with more than 50 years of claims-handling and adjuster experience, Triple G documents the damage, explains the policy and meets the adjuster. Coverage decisions belong to the carrier.

**Does Triple G do more than roofing?**
Yes — siding, fascia and soffit, gutters, attic venting, exterior paint, patio covers, pergolas, decks, fences and gates. Roofing, siding, gutters, patio covers, decks and fences — one call.

**What warranty comes with the work?**
Shingles carry a manufacturer warranty; proper attic ventilation matters because manufacturers can void or limit that warranty when the attic is not properly ventilated. Ask Triple G for the workmanship guarantee terms for your specific project.
